FIELDS.NAME: Color Harmony Paints
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Color Harmony Paints, we specialize in retailing a wide selection of paint, wallpaper, and related supplies, catering to both residential and commercial customers. Our operations are located in a modern retail space situated within a commercial shopping center, designed to provide a welcoming and organized environment for our clients. We focus on offering a variety of high-quality paint brands and eco-friendly options, along with expert color matching and consultation services conducted in-store. Our knowledgeable staff is trained in safely handling and providing guidance on our product offerings, and we maintain comprehensive safety data sheets (SDS) for all relevant materials. Additionally, we engage with community events and workshops, fostering customer engagement and promoting best practices in home improvement.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Color Harmony Home Supplies, LLC - Retail sales of home improvement products including tools, brushes, and adhesives located at 456 Color Lane, Springfield, IL 62701.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 03/12/2023; Cause: Water damage due to a burst pipe in the storage area; Amount: $1,000.00; Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class II, Grade A, UL Label
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the property to enhance safety and deter potential theft or vandalism.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Color Harmony Paints does not store, treat, discharge, apply, dispose, or transport hazardous materials as part of its retail operations. The business complies with safety standards and regulations related to hazardous material handling.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Color Harmony Paints does not sponsor any athletic teams. The focus of the business is solely on providing retail paint and wallpaper products and related services.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The store manager, John Smith, is responsible for checking the certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions of any degree related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime for any applicant associated with Color Harmony Paints.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years for Color Harmony Paints.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Color Harmony Paints does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff are directly employed by the business.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Color Harmony Paints does not carry Workers' Compensation insurance as the nature of the business operations does not require it. All employees are adequately compensated, and the store remains compliant with applicable regulations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Color Harmony Paints also operates Color Harmony Home Supplies, LLC, which focuses on retail sales of home improvement products, including tools and adhesives.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Color Harmony Paints does not currently have any other insurance policies with this company. The only insurance policy held is the one listed for the business operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Color Harmony Paints is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The business solely focuses on retailing paint, wallpaper, and related supplies without any manufacturing activities.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Color Harmony Paints does not rent or loan equipment to others, focusing solely on retail sales of paint and wallpaper without any equipment rental services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Color Harmony Paints has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business maintains a stable financial position without these issues affecting its operations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Color Harmony Paints does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals beyond standard retail operations, as all applicable safety and handling protocols are in place.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Color Harmony Paints does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are confined to a retail environment without involvement in high-risk activities or significant hazards. We maintain compliance with safety and regulatory standards to mitigate potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Color Harmony Paints has not had any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong commitment to workplace safety and non-discrimination policies.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Color Harmony Paints has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all fire safety regulations.
